kpis.quote: Revenue for the three and nine months ended May 31, 2026 and 2025 of $8.2 million and $22.5 million, and $5.1 million and $14.9 million, respectively

For the three months ended May 31, 2026 and 2025, we reported total revenue of $8.2 million and $5.1 million, respectively, with $4.7 million and $2.1 million being generated in our water and wastewater resource development segment
Lot sales revenue increased to $3.0 million for the three months ended May 31, 2026 compared to $2.5 million in the same period in 2025.
Net income for the three and nine months ended May 31, 2026 and 2025 of $2.9 million and $8.6 million, and $2.3 million and $7.0 million, respectively
EBITDA for the three and nine months ended May 31, 2026 and 2025 of $4.7 million and $13.6 million, and $3.6 million and $11.3 million, respectively
Earnings per fully diluted common share for the three and nine months ended May 31, 2026 and 2025 of $0.12 and $0.36, and $0.09 and $0.29, respectively.
Water deliveries increased for the three months ended May 31, 2026 to 631 acre-feet delivered as compared to 76 acre-feet delivered in the same period in 2025.
During the three months ended May 31, 2026 and 2025, the Company sold a total of 66 and 40 water taps, respectively
During the three months ended May 31, 2026 and 2025, the Company sold a total of 48 and 40 wastewater taps, respectively

guidance.text: The company expects to substantially complete Phase 2D by the end of fiscal 2026.
guidance.quote: We expect to substantially complete Phase 2D by the end of fiscal 2026 and collect the related contractual milestone and finished-lot payments

guidance.text: The company expects to complete approximately 159 lots in fiscal 2027.
guidance.quote: With Phase 2E, we expect to complete approximately 159 lots in fiscal 2027, paced to match builder absorption.

guidance.text: The company currently expects continued demand for oil and gas water sales through the remainder of 2026.
guidance.quote: Our current expectation is for continued demand for oil and gas water sales for the remainder of 2026.

guidance.text: The company expects approximately $14.8 million in milestone and finished-lot payments over the next 12 months.
guidance.quote: We expect to receive approximately $14.8 million in milestone and finished lot payments from our homebuilder customers over the next 12 months

guidance.text: The majority of the 23 additional contracted rental units are expected to be available for rent in calendar 2026.
guidance.quote: The majority of which we expect to be available for rent in calendar 2026.

data.summary: Third-quarter revenue, net income, EBITDA, diluted EPS, water deliveries, and tap sales increased from the prior-year period. Results were driven by higher water and wastewater activity, lot sales, and single-family rental revenue, with management advancing Phase 2D and beginning Phase 2E development.
